pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The dark contiguous regions exhibit high-frequency, jagged edge angularity with dendritic or 'leaf-like' extensions. The spatial area of the polygons is larger and more consolidated on the mid-flank, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented geometries toward the lower neck and extremities.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The negative-space pathways form a continuous, light-cream topological grid. Junction nodes are clearly defined with frequent 3-way and 4-way intersections. The pixel thickness of the corridors remains relatively consistent across the mid-flank, narrowing slightly at the sharpest vertices of the dark patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal-cervical midline presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated 1D contour. The pixel gradient at the boundary shows a consistent texture of short, vertical hair bundles against the background.
